trips.route_note: Greyhound or Jefferson Lines runs direct buses from Minneapolis to Duluth in about 2.5-3 hours along I-35.
see: Canal Park and Aerial Lift Bridge
trips.why: Direct Greyhound/Jefferson Lines buses reach Duluth in about 3 hours, fast and frequent enough to skip driving.
know: Book bus seats ahead in summer and around holidays
Canal Park and the lakewalk are the classic first stops
Summer is the peak season; winters are harsh

bus.via: Tulsa Campus to Oklahoma State University–Stillwater

trips.route_note: No direct rail; take a Metro Transit bus or rideshare about 30-40 minutes east along the St. Croix River to downtown Stillwater.
trips.why: No direct rail and the listed bus option is absurdly long, so a short 38-minute drive is clearly better.
know: Best in summer and fall for riverfront walks and foliage
Weekends get busy, so go early
Historic downtown is compact and walkable once there

train.via: St. Paul-Minneapolis to Red Wing Station

trips.route_note: Amtrak Empire Builder or a Jefferson Lines/Greyhound bus runs from Minneapolis to Red Wing in roughly 1-1.5 hours along the Mississippi.
trips.tour_query: Red Wing day trip from Minneapolis
trips.why: Amtrak's Empire Builder drops you at Red Wing station in roughly 1-1.5 hours along the Mississippi.
know: Amtrak runs limited daily services, so check times and book ahead
Fall is prime for river bluffs and foliage
Downtown and the riverfront are near the station
